parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the approval process. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144642.html operation to obtain the ID of the approval process
parameters.help_zh: 审批流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144642.html 获取该参数的值
parameters.name: workflow_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The action that you want to perform on the ticket. Valid values:

AGREE
CANCEL
REJECT
TRANSFER
ADD_APPROVAL_NODE
parameters.help_zh:
审批动作，取值及说明如下：
AGREE：同意。
CANCEL：取消。
REJECT：拒绝。
TRANSFER：转交。
ADD_APPROVAL_NODE：加签
parameters.name: approval_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user to which the ticket is transferred. If ApprovalType is set to TRANSFER, you need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 被转交用户的ID。ApprovalType参数为TRANSFER时必填
parameters.name: new_approver

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user that transfers the ticket to another user. The default value is the ID of the current user. If the current user is an administrator or a database administrator (DBA), the user can change the value of this parameter to the ID of another user
parameters.help_zh: 转交用户的ID，默认为当前操作用户的ID。当用户为管理员或DBA时，可指定其他相关人员的ID
parameters.name: old_approver

parameters.help_en: If ApprovalType is set to ADD_APPROVAL_NODE, you need to specify this parameter. The ID of the user that is added as the new approval node. This node must be a user-defined approval node. You can call the ListUserDefineWorkFlowNodes operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
ApprovalType为ADD_APPROVAL_NODE时必填。
添加的审批节点ID，该节点必须为用户自定义审批节点
parameters.name: approval_node_id

parameters.help_en:
The position of the new approval node. You must specify this parameter if ApprovalType is set to ADD_APPROVAL_NODE. Valid values:

PRE_ADD_APPROVAL_NODE: before the current approval node.
POST_ADD_APPROVAL_NODE: after the current approval node
parameters.help_zh:
ApprovalType为ADD_APPROVAL_NODE时必填。
加签的位置，取值及说明如下：

PRE_ADD_APPROVAL_NODE：前加签。
POST_ADD_APPROVAL_NODE：后加签
parameters.name: approval_node_pos

parameters.help_en:
You can specify this parameter if ApprovalType is set to TRANSFER. You need to only specify one of NewApproverList and NewApprover.

The IDs of the users to whom the ticket is transferred. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
ApprovalType为TRANSFER（转交）时填写。NewApprover参数与本参数二选一填写即可。

被转交用户的ID列表，用户ID之间使用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: new_approver_list

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account that actually calls the API
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID。<props="china">更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2835451.html。</props>
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
